title: Weird Algorithm
summary: Start with n. If even, divide by 2. If odd, multiply by 3 and add 1. Repeat until n is 1.
common_pitfalls: Using 32-bit int instead of 64-bit long long (intermediate values exceed 2^31 - 1 for inputs like n = 113383).

title: Missing Number
summary: Given all numbers between 1 and n except one, find the missing number.
common_pitfalls: Integer overflow when computing n * (n + 1) / 2 using 32-bit int.
Using O(n log n) sorting when O(n) math or XOR is cleaner.

title: Repetitions
summary: Given a DNA string (A, C, G, T), find the length of the longest substring containing only one type of character.
common_pitfalls: Forgetting to update the maximum answer when the longest streak ends at the very last character of the string.
Initializing the current streak counter to 0 instead of 1.
